rationale: NOT a verdict fixture: this is an INPUT config the harness MUST refuse with exit 1. Ring size 33554432 (32 MiB) exceeds the schema's documented maximum of 16777216 (16 MiB); the harness's --ring-size range check rejects it with a diagnostic that names the field and the allowed bound. The harness refuses to start when this config is presented via --ring-size. A privileged runner (task 53+) MUST reject the same way.
